title: Housings / Chambers / Enclosures
description: Box/cylindrical thin-wall structure with mounting lugs, flanges, viewports
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) offers 45% weight reduction vs stainless steel. For aerospace/medical housings. Use Grade 2 CP-Ti if only corrosion resistance needed.
Form: Plate welding is most economical for housings. CNC cutting + automated welding reduces allowance. Consider investment casting for high volume.
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B265 Gr5 annealed plate, post-weld stress relief, 100% PT
